The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). This action is compliant with legal standards, as the FCRA regulates the collection, dissemination, and use of consumer credit information and requires employers to obtain written consent and provide specific disclosures before conducting background checks for employment purposes. By adhering to these requirements, the bank is following federal regulations.
